gold.taskTitle: Learn Hand-Lettering for Wedding Envelope Addressing
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn the skill of hand-lettering envelopes specifically for wedding stationery purposes.

questions.title: What lettering style are you drawn to — calligraphy, brush lettering, or print?
questions.description: Identify the specific style the user wants to learn.

questions.title: How many envelopes do you need to letter in total?
questions.description: Understand the scale and volume of the project.

questions.title: What is the deadline for completing all the envelopes?
questions.description: Establish the timeline to pace learning and practice.

questions.title: Do you have any prior experience with calligraphy or hand-lettering?
questions.description: Gauge the user's current skill level to tailor the learning path.

questions.title: Are you open to taking a class, or do you prefer self-teaching?
questions.description: Determine the preferred learning method and format.

questions.title: What tools do you currently own — pens, nibs, ink, or brushes?
questions.description: Identify what supplies the user already has versus what they need to acquire.

questions.title: What size and paper type are the envelopes you will be addressing?
questions.description: Understand the physical constraints that affect tool choice and technique.
